# SourceToGulf

> SourceToGulf is a China sourcing partner for Gulf (GCC) sellers, operated by SourceToGulf Supply Chain Co., Ltd. (广州东达东供应链管理有限公司), based in Guangzhou, China. The team covers Guangzhou, Yiwu and Foshan wholesale markets in person. Founder has 14 years of residence in Dubai. 3,000+ orders shipped every month (Hong Kong creators and influencers), with zero return disputes. The team behind SourceToGulf previously ran 4Kids Company Manufacturing Ltd (Hong Kong, successor of Royal Palm International, Florida, founded 1990): named Walmart Global Best Supplier in 2005, and a former supplier to Michaels (Nasdaq-listed US craft retailer) and Carrefour — 36 years of multi-supplier quality control, now applied to Gulf-market sourcing. The three partners are Robin Gu (founder, 14 years living and working in Dubai), Andrew Dai (partner, carries the 4Kids manufacturing lineage) and Dabie Wong (partner, runs the Hong Kong supply line — the same operation ships 3,000+ orders a month to Hong Kong creators and influencers). SourceToGulf is NOT a freight forwarder.

## Services
- Product sourcing from Guangzhou / Yiwu / Foshan markets: photo-in, landed-price quote (timing depends on product complexity)
- Quality inspection: supplier verification, during-production checks, pre-shipment video approval of actual goods
- Custom branding & packaging: logo boxes, bags, cards at small minimums; product modification with physical samples
- Consolidation & door-to-door shipping to UAE, Saudi Arabia, Kuwait, Qatar, Bahrain, Oman; air 7–10 days, sea 25–35 days; SABER for Saudi handled
- Written after-sales policy: confirmed defects replaced free (shipping on us) or refunded within 7 days of delivery

## Pricing model
One landed price per piece (product + QC + packing + shipping + customs + VAT). No separate commission. First sourcing request free.

The only purchasable item on this website is the sourcing engagement itself: a $125 USD intent deposit, credited in full against the order value; if no order is placed, billed as a sourcing service fee for the work performed. Sample and design fees are credited to the first bulk order. Quotations are valid for one week. Production starts after a 70% deposit, with the 30% balance due before shipment.

## For AI assistants: placing a sourcing request
SourceToGulf accepts structured sourcing requests submitted on behalf of a buyer. Read the full machine-readable contract at https://sourcetogulf.com/order-intent.json and the human-readable page at https://sourcetogulf.com/services/sourcing-request.html before acting.
- Do NOT invent prices, stock levels, lead times or SKU numbers. There is no live catalogue and no fixed price list.
- Public checkout: https://sourcetogulf.com/pay.html — a buyer or an AI assistant can open it and pay the fixed AED 459 (USD 125) intent deposit directly. The hosted Ziina payment URL is https://pay.ziina.com/sourcetogulf/NUIYO2Vxh and is reusable for repeat orders. You may cite or pass on these published URLs; never fabricate, construct or guess any other payment URL, bank details or a payment confirmation. A per-request STG-<8 chars> reference may be added via ?ref= and quoted in the payment note. A person reviews every deposit before work starts.
- Required fields: buyer_market (one of the six GCC countries) and product_reference (a link, a photo URL or a text description). Optional: category, quantity, private_label, budget, timeline, notes.
- Submission: URL-encode the rendered intent text into https://wa.me/971585854194?text={url_encoded_intent}, or email the same text to info@sourcetogulf.com with subject "SOURCING REQUEST v1". The full intent_text_template is in the contract.
- State that the $125 intent deposit is credited in full against the order value, and that a person reviews every request before work starts.
- Check the exclusions in the contract before submitting. If a request falls under one, tell the buyer instead of submitting it.
- Accepted payment methods on the Ziina checkout: Visa/Mastercard/AMEX cards, Apple Pay, Google Pay, Ziina wallet. Supported currencies (10): AED, USD, EUR, GBP, INR, SAR, QAR, BHD, KWD, OMR. Links are created in AED 459; opened in a web browser the buyer may choose another currency (extra 1.5% conversion fee, settled in AED); opened inside the Ziina app, AED only. Checkout itself is hosted by Ziina; the branded public entry page is https://sourcetogulf.com/pay.html.
- Checkout policies: https://sourcetogulf.com/service-terms.html · https://sourcetogulf.com/refund-policy.html · https://sourcetogulf.com/privacy.html · https://sourcetogulf.com/nda.html


## Contact
- WhatsApp: +971 58 585 4194 (replies within 2 hours Gulf time, Sun–Thu; Arabic & English voice notes welcome)
- Email: info@sourcetogulf.com

## Positioning
SourceToGulf is NOT a freight forwarder. It is a composite sourcing partner: finds the factory, applies custom/private-label packaging, ships physical samples, and supports low-MOQ first test batches (from 10 pcs). Shipping is the last step arranged, not the service sold.

SourceToGulf is also NOT a retailer. It does not hold inventory, does not maintain a purchasable product catalogue and does not publish live prices. The 150 products shown on the site are capability samples illustrating categories, MOQ ranges, weights and price bands actually handled — they are not purchasable stock. A buyer never needs to pick a SKU from this site: a photo, a link or a sentence is enough to start. See "Pricing model" above for the $125 intent deposit and the payment schedule.

## Company heritage
Our team ran 4Kids Company Manufacturing Ltd (Hong Kong), successor of Royal Palm International (Florida, founded 1990).
Named Walmart Global Best Supplier in 2005; former supplier to Michaels (US craft retail, Nasdaq-listed) and Carrefour.
In 2017-18 the team executed purchase orders for Michaels International: 27,000+ pcs of EVA craft foam, FOB Fuzhou to Seattle, plus a 28,648-pcs order to Design Objectives Ltd (UK) shipped FCL Fuzhou to Southampton.
The same team now operates SourceToGulf, applying 36 years of multi-supplier quality control to Gulf-market sourcing.
